schema:
Summarise scripts/probe_planted_attention.py shards -> paper/data/planted_attention.json.

python3 scripts/summarize_planted_attention.py --dir <OUT> [--json paper/data/planted_attention.json]

All statistics are per chain first (one planted value per chain), then averaged over chains; 95% CIs are percentile bootstraps
over chains (2000 resamples). Attention is averaged over heads (and, write side, over the query slots the layer keeps).
"Layer average" = unweighted mean over the 36 layers; "L256/L128/L64" = mean over the layers of that quota group.

JSON schema (also stored under "schema"):
  meta: n_chains, n_problems, ks, planted_block counts, layer_q, layer_groups, recall (exact % per k, plant and unplanted)
  write: {group: {span: {share, enrichment}}} group in all|L256|L128|L64, span in digits|name|sentence|control_number|
         other_digits|random4. share = attention mass on the span / attention mass on block b's raw tokens (per layer,
         then averaged over layers of the group); enrichment = share / (span length / 512). Each leaf {mean, ci, n}.
         Also write.per_layer.{digits,control_number,name}: enrichment per layer (list of 36 {mean, ci}),
         write.digits_over_control: per-chain ratio enrichment(digits)/enrichment(control) (layer-average), {mean, median, ci},
         write.tot: mean over chains/layers of [raw block, prompt, earlier codes, new codes, sum] masses.
         write.head_max: layer-average of the max-over-heads enrichment per span; write.frac_heads_enrich_gt2: fraction of
         (layer, head) pairs with enrichment > 2; write.top_heads_crossfit: mean enrichment on the TOPN heads chosen by digit
         enrichment on the other half of the chains (even/odd gidx), per span; write.top_heads_all_chains: the TOPN heads.
  read: {cond: {k: {query: {split: {group: {...}}}}}}
         cond in plant|unplanted; k in 1,2,4,8,all (all = pooled over k, per-chain mean over k);
         query in first_digit (the query that predicts the first digit) | digits (mean over the 4 queries predicting digits);
         split in all|correct|wrong (recall exact on the planted chain at that k; for unplanted the planted chain's label);
         group in all|L256|L128|L64. Leaf fields:
           per_row: {offset: {mean, ci, n}} attention mass on block (b+offset)'s code rows / rows kept in that layer
           mass:    {offset: {mean, ci, n}} raw attention mass on that block's code rows (not normalised)
           prompt_per_token, current_per_token, prompt_mass, current_mass, codes_mass: {mean, ci, n}
           peak_ratio: per-row mass at offset 0 / mean per-row mass over the other earlier blocks (per chain) {mean, ci, n}
  read_per_layer: {cond: {k: {per_row_offset0: [36 x {mean, ci}], peak_ratio: [36 x {mean, ci}]}}} (query=digits, split=all)
  sanity: max |sum of attention - 1| over all captured rows (read) and code-step queries (write)

meta.layer_average: unweighted mean over layers (all 36, or the layers of one quota group)
